Before water was added the entry used the dry-only td-Toth fit of Low et al. (Table 7, engine kind 'toth_2'): q_inf,0 = 3.00 mmol/g, chi = 0.7, T0 = 298.15 K, b = b0 exp(-dH/(R T)) with b0 = 2.0e-11 kPa^-1 and dH = -70.1 kJ/mol (stored as b0 at T0 = b0 exp(70100/(R T0)) in Pa^-1), tau0 = 0.431, alpha = 1.4e-10. These water parameters are NOT the engine's gab_young defaults (the Young et al. 2021 values reprinted in Low SI Table S5); Low states that those fit their 308 K data but deviate at 288 and 298 K. The engine has one T_0 for both sites; the paper references the dry site to 308 K (printed as 308, not 308.15) and the wet site to 298.15 K, so T_0 = 308 K and the wet site is re-referenced by the exact relations chi' = chi T0'/T0, q' = q exp(chi - chi'), alpha' = alpha T0/T0', t0' = t0 + alpha - alpha' (T0 = 298.15 K, T0' = 308 K; derived values are marked in the table). The paper's b0 is the affinity at T0 in kPa^-1, the engine's has no reference temperature, so b0_dry = b0 exp(-dH/(R T0)) = 2.96 exp(-77800/(8.314462618 x 308)) 1/Pa = 1.8933e-13 1/Pa; b0_wet = 31 kPa^-1 = 0.031 1/Pa (dH_wet = 0). Stored values: T_0 = 308 K; dry q_inf = 1.17, chi = 0.49, b0 = 1.8933e-13 1/Pa, dH = 77800 J/mol, tau0 = 0.25, alpha = 0.19; wet q_inf = 1.5015 (1.62 exp(2.3 - 2.3760)), chi = 2.3760 (2.3 x 308/298.15), b0 = 0.031 1/Pa, dH = 0, tau0 = 1.1567 (1.0 + 4.9 - 4.7433), alpha = 4.7433 (4.9 x 298.15/308); A = 2.8 mol/kg. The water weighting uses the actual adsorbed water loading; the paper's fits use the equilibrium loading at the measured RH, which is the same at equilibrium.
